title: phyteuma orbiculare subsp. anglicum
intro: Phyteuma orbiculare subsp. anglicum, commonly known as English Masterwort or Masterwort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, and it is said to have several health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders. The therapeutic actions of Phyteuma orbiculare subsp. anglicum include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, relieve muscle spasms, and facilitate the removal of mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
